turns.question: By how many euros did our average order grow from August to September 2026?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no metric for a change in average order value, so I can only give the two figures it computed: average order value (revenue over non-cancelled orders) was 92.25 EUR for 1-31 August 2026 and 114.39 EUR for 1-30 September 2026, so September is higher than August. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
